pairs.registryProposal: unpriced-span-accounting decision rule exempts latency ("a missing latency treated as zero merely makes a duration conservative"); that holds for one span inside a summed total but not when the coerced value is the run's ONLY duration figure, where 0 ms is a fabricated measurement. Narrow the carve-out: zero-default is acceptable as a summand, never as the sole displayed value.
